caption:
Stop judging your video ads by clicks alone.

Two numbers tell you exactly where an ad breaks:

Hook rate: of everyone who saw it, how many watched the first 3 seconds. This is your opening doing its job.

Hold rate: of those, how many kept watching to the middle or the end. This is your message doing its job.

How to read them:
→ Low hook: the opening is the problem. Change the first line or first image
→ High hook, low hold: you grabbed attention with something the rest of the video doesn't deliver
→ Both high, few clicks: the offer or the call to action is the problem

One ad, three different fixes. Most people change the whole thing and learn nothing.

Comment "HOOK" and I'll show you where to find these numbers in Ads Manager.
